home.kicker: Menyetla ya phumantsho ya Afrika Borwa
home.headline: Moo bafani ba SA ba kopanang le phumantsho ya nnete.
home.intro: Batla lithendara tsa sechaba tse hlahlobiloeng ka bo eona le li-RFQ ho ea ka indasteri, profinse le letsatsi la ho koala — ka likhokahano tsa mehloli ea mantlha.
home.sourceNote: Menyetla ea sechaba e tsoang lethathamong la thepa ea molao.
home.supplierBody: Fumana menyetla. Netefatsoa. Holisa khoebo ea hau.
home.smartScoreBody: E hahiloe ka bopaki bo hlahlobiloeng ba ho latela melao le netefatso ea banka.
home.buyerBody: Mohloli o netefalitsoeng ke barekisi. Setšoantšo sa RFQ. Laola mantsoe a qotsitsoeng.
home.trackedDaily: Theko ea sechaba, e lateloa letsatsi le letsatsi
home.statsBody: Menyetla ea hajoale ho tsoa ho li-eTender tsa mmuso, tse hlahlobiloeng ka bo eona bakeng sa litsebiso tse hlakotsoeng kapa tse seng li fanoe.
home.screened: E hlahlobiloe ka mokhoa o itekanetseng
home.network: Marang-rang a ho reka thepa Afrika Boroa esale a emetse.
home.registerSupplier: Ngolisa joalo ka mofani oa thepa
home.supplierPoint1: Ngola khoebo ea hau. Kenya nomoro ea hau ea CSD le setifikeiti sa B-BBEE.
home.supplierPoint2: Fumana SmartScore - lintlha tsa hau tsa ts'epo, tse bonoang ke moreki e mong le e mong.
home.supplierPoint3: Li-RFQ tse tšoanang li tla ho uena. Ha ho na matsatsi a ho koala a fetiloeng.
home.verified48: E netefalitsoe ka lihora tse 48. Ha ho karete ea mokoloto.
home.smartScoreIntro: Morekisi e mong le e mong o na le SmartScore-e hlahlobiloeng khahlanong le mehloli e mene ea semmuso ea SA, e hlahlobiloeng ke sehlopha sa rona.
home.smartScoreRank: Fumana lintlha tse 90 kapa ho feta 'me boemo ba hau bo lula pele ho lipatlisiso tsa bareki.
home.buyerPoint1: Romella RFQ ka metsotso e mehlano. Beha litlhoko tsa hau tsa B-BBEE, profinse, le mofuta oa boleng.
home.buyerPoint2: Barekisi ba netefalitsoeng ba tsebisoa hang-hang.
home.buyerPoint3: Bapisa mantsoe a qotsitsoeng ka mahlakoreng - e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe e na le SmartScore le beche ea netefatso.
home.verifiedOrganisations: Bakeng sa mekhatlo e netefalitsoeng. Bomasepala ba amohelehile.
home.trustOfficialTitle: E Tiisitsoe Khahlanong le Lirekoto tsa Semmuso
home.trustOfficialBody: CSD, SARS, CIPC le bopaki ba libanka - bo hlahlobiloe ke sehlopha sa rona pele ho hlaha mofani ofe kapa ofe.
home.trustMatchingBody: Menyetla e bulehileng e tsamaisana le liprofaele tsa barekisi ke indasteri e ngolisitsoeng le provense.
home.trustNotificationsBody: Barekisi ba tsebisoa ka mor'a metsotso e seng mekae ka mor'a hore RFQ e tšoanang e behoe.
home.trustAuditBody: Khoutu e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe, khau, le thekisetsano li bolokoa 'me li romelloa kantle ho naha bakeng sa tlhahlobo ea theko.
